segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹאֵל אֶת הַפָּרָה, שְׁאָלָהּ חֲצִי יוֹם וּשְׂכָרָהּ חֲצִי יוֹם. שְׁאָלָהּ הַיּוֹם וּשְׂכָרָהּ לְמָחָר. שָׂכַר אַחַת וְשָׁאַל אַחַת, וּמֵתָה. הַמַּשְׁאִיל אוֹמֵר: שְׁאוּלָה מֵתָה, בְּיוֹם שֶׁהָיְתָה שְׁאוּלָה מֵתָה,
segments.en: «MISHNA:» There is «one who borrowed a cow. He borrowed it» for «half» of the «day and rented it» for the other «half» of the «day;» or «he borrowed it» for «today and rented it» for «tomorrow;» or «he rented one» cow «and borrowed» another «one» from the same person. «And» in one of the first two cases, the cow «died» and it is not clear during which period the cow died. Or in the last case, one of the cows died and it is not clear whether it had been the borrowed cow or the rented cow. If «the lender» then «says:» The «borrowed» cow is the one that «died;» or: «It died on the day that it was» being «borrowed;»

segments.he: בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁהָיְתָה שְׁאוּלָה מֵתָה. וְהַלָּה אוֹמֵר: אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ – חַיָּיב.
segments.en: or: «It died during the period in which it was» being «borrowed,» so that, according to his claim, the borrower is liable to pay for the cow, «and the other» one, the borrower, «says: I do not know» what happened, the borrower is «liable» to pay.

segments.he: הַשּׂוֹכֵר אוֹמֵר: שְׂכוּרָה מֵתָה, בְּיוֹם שֶׁהָיְתָה שְׂכוּרָה מֵתָה, בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁהָיְתָה שְׂכוּרָה מֵתָה. וְהַלָּה אוֹמֵר: אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ – פָּטוּר.
segments.en: If «the renter says:» The «rented» cow is the one that «died;» or: «It died on the day that it was» being «rented;» or: «It died during the period in which it was» being «rented, and the other» one, the owner of the cow, «says: I do not know» what happened, the renter is «exempt.»

segments.he: זֶה אוֹמֵר: שְׁאוּלָה, וְזֶה אוֹמֵר: שְׂכוּרָה – יִשָּׁבַע הַשּׂוֹכֵר שֶׁשְּׂכוּרָה מֵתָה.
segments.en: If «this» owner «says» with certitude: The «borrowed» cow is the one that died, «and that» renter «says» with certitude: The «rented» cow is the one that died, then «the renter takes an oath that the rented» cow is the one that «died,» and he is then exempt from liability.

segments.he: זֶה אוֹמֵר: אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ, וְזֶה אוֹמֵר: אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ – יַחְלוֹקוּ.
segments.en: If «this» one «says: I do not know» what happened, «and that» one «says: I do not know» what happened, then «they divide» the disputed amount. The bailee is liable to pay for only half the value of the cow.
